item.title: Hawaii Five-O - The Second Shot
item.description: An opposition leader for Greece is living in exile in Hawaii.

item.title: Matlock - Court Martial, The (Part 1)
item.description: Matlock is hired by a friend to defend his enlisted son. The boy's been charged with killing a sadistic lieutenant whose mistreatment led to the death of another soldier.

item.title: Perry Mason - The Case of the Hateful Hero
item.description: Young cop Jimmy Anderson and his veteran partner come across a robbery at the Wilson Plastics Company while on patrol one night. His partner killed in the ensuing shootout, evidence then points to Jimmy as having been an accomplice.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Wally's Girl Trouble
item.description: Wally and Beaver dread attending dance school, so when Wally suddenly takes a liking in it, June and Ward are dumbfounded. It seems Wally has developed a crush on a girl named Penny and Beaver soon feels neglected and left out when Wally begins spending all his time with her.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Water, Anyone
item.description: "Wally and his friends are trying to earn enough money to buy baseball uniforms so they put a plan into action by doing their chores at a slow pace in order to maximize their hourly pay. Meanwhile, Beaver, also wanting to be on the team, begins selling water to his family and neighbors."

item.title: Toon In With Me - Outhousing
item.description: "Bill and Toony sign up to compete in an outhouse race."

item.title: Adam-12 - Who Won?
item.description: Malloy and reed try to curb a chronic street racing problem by befriending the club leaders and working with a racing promoter to open a legitimate drag strip. Their efforts, along with a highly anticipated race between reed and officer wells, are put in

item.title: Adam-12 - Back-up One L-20
item.description: While transporting a burglar to the station with Malloy's assistance, Sgt. MacDonald strikes and kills a jaywalker with his cruiser, but unfortunately all of the witnesses on the sidewalk inexplicably claim she was in the crosswalk. With the burglar unmotivated to testify on MacDonald's behalf, Malloy has to take it upon himself to clear his boss.

item.title: Dragnet - Intelligence: DR 34
item.description: The detectives search out the suppliers of stolen arms for paramilitary groups.

item.title: Dragnet - Frauds: DR 36
item.description: Friday and Gannon track down a department store employee who stole $100,000 worth of merchandise in six months.
